# Volume 2 timeline

## I An Irate Neighbor

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is daydreaming outside when her new neighbor, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), angrily confronts her after her cow breaks into his oatfield. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss the encounter and local news over tea, joined by Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who shares gossip about upcoming changes and new residents in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discuss [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's past relationship and his son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), coming to live in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). The conversation shifts to Anne's plan to start a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), which Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) warns will be difficult. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) also shares that Anne's friend [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) has been hired to teach at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P50](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0050), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P54](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0054), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057)_

## II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Martin](../character/martin.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Shearer](../character/shearer.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) plans on their drive home from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) when they spot a Jersey cow trampling Mr. Harrison's oat field. Believing the cow is her own nuisance Jersey, [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) impulsively sells the stray cow on the spot to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md) for twenty dollars. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers [Dolly](../character/dolly.md) still in the barnyard and realizes she accidentally sold Mr. Harrison's cow, prompting her to head over to his house with the money and a cake to confess.

_Sources: [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P12](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0012), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P24](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0024), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P35](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0035), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P42](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0042)_

## III Mr. Harrison at Home

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to Mr. Harrison's home to confess that she accidentally sold his Jersey cow, but he receives the news calmly, insults from his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md) notwithstanding. After trading cows and sharing tea and cake, the two form an unexpected friendship. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home relieved and shares the outcome with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P8](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0008), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P20](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0020), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P35](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0035)_

## IV Different Opinions

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — On the eve of the school term, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses teaching methods and classroom discipline with [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), strongly opposing corporal punishment. After returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also doubts her plan to rule by affection rather than the rod. The next morning, a nervous [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) drinks ginger tea prepared by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) before starting her first day of teaching.

_Sources: [v2 IV Different Opinions P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 IV Different Opinions P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007), [v2 IV Different Opinions P35](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0035), [v2 IV Different Opinions P41](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0041)_

## V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Clair Donnell](../character/clair-donnell.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Morley, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Prillie Rogerson](../character/prillie-rogerson.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) begins her first day of teaching at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, meeting her students—including the sullen [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) and the imaginative [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)—and dealing with minor classroom infractions. After school, Mrs. H. B. Donnell confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with pretentious demands about her children's names, but [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) cheers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) up by gifting her wild orchids. Returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her day with [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P20](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0020)_

## VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Catherine Andrews](../character/catherine-andrews.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) begin canvassing for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) to raise money for the hall. After facing a grim refusal from [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), they receive a secret donation from [Catherine Andrews](../character/catherine-andrews.md), assist Daniel Blair with baking a cake in exchange for a subscription, and navigate Mrs. Theodore White's extreme cleanliness to secure another contribution.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P16](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0016), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P36](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0036)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue canvassing [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for subscriptions, encountering peculiar neighbors like the hyper-neat Mrs. Theodore White and receiving mixed results. Learning that [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md) just had a new baby boy, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) strategically visits him while he is overjoyed, securing a generous five-dollar donation. Later that evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to ask for a contribution, but he flatly refuses.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P37](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0037), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P44](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0044), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P49](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0049), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056)_

## VII The Pointing of Duty

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) chat about their creative efforts, teaching experiences, and ambitions for the future. After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home with news that their sick cousin Mary cannot care for the Keith twins, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to persuade [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to take them in for the winter.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P3](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0003), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P12](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0012), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P23](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0023), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P33](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0033)_

## VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

**Aid Society, [Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), Green Gables, [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) brings the twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith, home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) quickly displays his mischievous and unruly nature. Over the next few days, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) causes trouble by dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck at church, making [Dora](../character/dora.md) fall into a pigpen, and hiding a toad in Marilla's bed.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md)** — [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he put a toad in Marilla's bed. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) quickly sneaks into Marilla's room and uses a shovel to remove the toad before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) can find it.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P56](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0056), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P61](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0061), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P62](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0062)_

## IX A Question of Color

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) converses with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) regarding Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and the ongoing hall improvement project. Shortly after [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) paints the hall a shocking bright blue due to a mix-up with the paint numbers, news spreads across town. [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Fred](../character/fred-wright.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and Oliver gather with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in shared dismay over the disaster.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P24](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0024), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032)_

## X Davy in Search of a Sensation

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Barry](../character/barry.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to find [Dora](../character/dora.md) missing and everyone frantically searching for her. After searching the well and surrounding area with Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse by [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md). [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) is confronted and tearfully promises never to lie again after realizing he made [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cry, though he later questions [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about Marilla's warning regarding prayers.

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P26](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0026), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) explains to [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) why his lie was the dreadful consequence of skipping his prayers, defending Marilla's honesty. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Davy's mischief and Dora's quiet perfection, agreeing that despite Davy's trouble, they feel a fond affection for him because he needs their guidance.

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P75](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0075), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P82](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0082), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P84](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0084), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P89](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0089)_

## XI Facts and Fancies

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Nora](../character/nora.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md)** — In a letter to [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares humorous anecdotes and student compositions from her teaching experience. The letter includes stories of classroom responses and student letters from Jacob, Annetta, Barbara, Willie, and [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md).

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_

**[Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) writes a letter describing his imaginary friends at the shore, including [Nora](../character/nora.md), the [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md), and the [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md). He narrates fantastical adventures with them, such as visiting the moon and sailing to the sunset, before concluding with a note that the story is not really true.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P44](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0044), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P46](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0046)_

## XII A Jonah Day

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Clair Donnell](../character/clair-donnell.md), [Joe Sloane](../character/joe-sloane.md), [Prillie Rogerson](../character/prillie-rogerson.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Chester Sloane](../character/chester-sloane.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md)** — In a bad mood from a toothache, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally causes fireworks to explode in the schoolroom and subsequently whips [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) after he puts a mouse in her desk. She goes home heartbroken over her bad day, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts her. The next morning, Anthony treats [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with new respect, and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) later confirms that the whipping gained his approval.

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P36](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0036), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049)_

## XIII A Golden Picnic

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invites her friends on a spring picnic walk to celebrate her unofficial birthday. Along their journey through the woods, the four girls name a hidden forest pool [Crystal Lake](../codex/places.md#crystal-lake) and explore a secluded path. They eventually stumble upon the overgrown, flower-filled garden of the late [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md), where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) shares Hester's touching love story.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P29](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0029), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's life and garden before spending the rest of the afternoon rambling in the woods. They enjoy lunch by a brook, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) poetically imagine nature and the imagery of souls. Afterward, the girls return home at sunset, having thoroughly enjoyed their outing.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P56](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0056), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P61](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0061), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P68](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0068), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P73](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0073)_

## XIV A Danger Averted

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses town matters with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) before returning home to learn from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that the twins must stay until fall. After dealing with Davy's jam-stealing and catechism confusions, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends an Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting where news breaks about [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) renting his fences for advertisements. The society sends a committee to reason with Judson, but he refuses to change his plans.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P0](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0000), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md), [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) try to convince [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) not to rent his fences for advertising, but he refuses. Later, after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally overhears Judson accepting a political bribe from [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md), Judson hastily agrees to drop the fence advertisements to ensure [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) keeps quiet.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P58](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0058), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P66](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0066)_

## XV The Beginning of Vacation

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes the school year and walks toward the cemetery, joining [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) along the way as he shares thoughts about his parents and rock people. At the graveyard, after tending to the graves of [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and they discuss teaching, ideals, and friendship on their walk home.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P2](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0002), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P24](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0024), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P26](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0026)_

## XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) questions [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about heaven after hearing a strange explanation from [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md), which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gently corrects. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then receives a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) announcing that author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) is coming to visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), prompting excited preparations by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

_Sources: [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P24](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0024)_

## XVII A Chapter of Accidents

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) decorate [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and prepare an elaborate meal in anticipation of guest Mrs. Morgan's arrival. After [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) accidentally ruins the lemon pies and Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) fails to show up, the remaining guests eat a quiet dinner that culminates in the destruction of Aunt Josephine's platter. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns via a letter that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle and will not be coming at all.

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P9](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0009), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P57](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0057), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — Following the broken platter incident, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) goes home and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns with a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) stating that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) cannot visit. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Anne's tendency to experience emotional highs and lows, plan how to reimburse [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), and chat about local gossip regarding Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) before [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives.

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P64](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0064), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P65](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0065), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P68](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0068)_

## XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) talk at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) before [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) signals [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to meet her. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about a willow-ware platter at the [Copp](../character/copp.md) place in [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale), and the two girls drive over the next day to get it. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gets trapped in the roof of an old duck house while trying to look through the window, but after a rainstorm, Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) [Copp](../character/copp.md) returns and releases her.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P0](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0000), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P15](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0015), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P34](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0034), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Copp](../character/copp.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) explains to [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) [Copp](../character/copp.md) why she looked into her pantry window, and the two agree on a price for the blue platter. After enjoying tea with [Sarah](../character/sarah.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) buys the platter for twenty-five dollars, and she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive back along the [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road) laughing over their adventures.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P56](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0056), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P60](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0060), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P62](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0062), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P64](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0064)_

## XIX Just a Happy Day

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends time with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), sharing tea and discussing his imaginative thoughts and childhood worries. Later at home, she tucks in [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), who deals with his feelings of jealousy toward [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md). Afterwards, she runs into [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) by the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble).

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P2](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0002), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P23](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0023), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) explains his good behavior before going to sleep. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), where they discuss the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village Improvement Society's ongoing plans and school updates. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) her list of tasks for the next day.

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P47](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0047), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P55](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0055), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P63](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0063)_

## XX The Way It Often Happens

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) departs with [Dora](../character/dora.md), leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) where she accidentally dyes her nose scarlet while changing feather beds. [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives with famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) for a visit. Despite her initial embarrassment, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hosts a successful dinner and walk with the guests before they depart.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P33](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0033), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P43](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0043)_

## XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md), [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to teaching school, where [Dora](../character/dora.md) is frightened by [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's stories about a ghost relative. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk through the woods to go to [West Grafton](../codex/places.md#west-grafton), but lose their way and discover [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), the quaint stone home of Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her young helper, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md). Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) warmly invites them to stay for a imaginary tea party she had set up to combat loneliness.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share tea with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her maid [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) explains her imaginary party and the origin of her echoes. After [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) demonstrates the echoing tin horn and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) explains her maid's given name, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) inadvertently mentions [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) briefly inquires about [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's son before bidding the girls a wistful goodbye.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P81](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0081), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P87](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0087)_

## XXII Odds and Ends

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — At the breakfast table, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Anne's visit with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and gossip about old town affairs while trying to keep [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) in check. Later, word arrives that [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) has died and left money in trust for the twins, ensuring that [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) can remain living at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) permanently.

_Sources: [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P0](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0000), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025)_

## XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), [Irving](../character/irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) on a wintry evening, and over tea and candy, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) recounts her long-ago romance and quarrel with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). A month later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) introduces Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and the two immediately form a fond friendship during their visit.

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P17](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0017), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026)_

## XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Ginger](../character/ginger.md)** — A massive hail and thunder storm strikes [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) on the exact day predicted in a lighthearted newspaper note, causing severe damage across the village. The family at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) weathered the violent hail inside, after which they learn that Mr. Harrison's parrot was killed. Later, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to discuss the storm's destruction and note the destruction of an old blighted house.

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P49](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0049)_

## XXV An Avonlea Scandal

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Emily](../character/emily.md), [Isabella Andrews](../character/isabella-andrews.md), [James A](../character/james-a.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — An unexpectedly neat woman arrives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) looking for Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) and reveals herself to be his wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), before heading over to his house. The news spreads quickly through the neighborhood, and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) eventually asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to come over so he can explain the whole story of their separation.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P28](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P55](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0055)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Emily](../character/emily.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains the history of his marriage, housecleaning disagreements, and parrot-related falling out with [Emily](../character/emily.md) to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). [Emily](../character/emily.md) returns from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), welcomes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to tea, and walks home with her while expressing regret over their past feud. At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discusses Mrs. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), while [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) affectionately expresses his fondness for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as she puts him to bed.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P60](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0060), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P65](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0065), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

## XXVI Around the Bend

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — After [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) dies, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) invites [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to move in at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) won't have to leave [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), which also allows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to leave her teaching post and attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). News of Anne's resignation and upcoming departure spreads among her students and friends, causing distress for [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P35](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0035)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md)** — [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) expresses her anxiety over [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaving for [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and asks about her feelings toward [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) assures [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) of her steadfast friendship and clarifies that she only views [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) as a friend while holding onto her romantic ideal.

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P45](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0045), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P46](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0046), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P61](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0061)_

## XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dresses in a new pale green dress and converses with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Dora](../character/dora.md) before leaving for [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) then walk to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where they eat lunch and visit with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) in the garden. Afterward, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) plays with the echoes while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) set out to pick early strawberries for tea.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P37](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0037)_

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) expresses concern to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about Miss Lavendar's unusual despondency and apathy. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) promises to come stay for a week during her vacation to help cheer Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) up. Meanwhile, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) bond over their shared experiences with imaginary dream-people before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) head home.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P49](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0049), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P62](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0062)_

## XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md)** — After school finishes, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and meets his returning father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), who asks her to pass a message to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers the note to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and helps her prepare for Stephen's arrival that evening.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P42](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0042), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057)_

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) help Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's visit to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). When [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) arrives, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) welcomes him and ushers him inside to meet Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) watch from the window as [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) walk in the garden together, confirming that the two have reconciled.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P64](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0064), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070)_

## XXIX Poetry and Prose

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)** — As wedding preparations for Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) continue, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) express their excitement about moving to [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston). Meanwhile, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on romance with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and later stumbles upon [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) sharing an intimate moment. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) later visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide her engagement to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to ponder her own future dreams of love.

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P2](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0002), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015)_

## XXX A Wedding at the Stone House

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Irving](../character/irving.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) help prepare for Miss Lavendar's wedding at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before the intimate ceremony takes place in the garden as the sun breaks through the clouds. After seeing the newly married couple off at the station, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) return to tidy up the house, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later shares a quiet, subtly meaningful moment with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before they leave.

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P40](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0040)_
